customManagers.description: npm pins documented inside the canonical rule files. These are the repo's real dependency surface — there is no package.json — and a stale pin here reaches every consumer at once.

packageRules.description: Keep rule-file pins grouped. Delivery remains a separate manual action.
Preserve the compiler API required by the WXT/Svelte example. Native checking uses a separate alias until a reviewed coordinated migration supports root TypeScript 7.
